arxiv-1908-09855.title: Detecting crosstalk errors in quantum information processors
arxiv-1908-09855.creator: Mohan Sarovar, Timothy Proctor, Kenneth Rudinger, Kevin Young, Erik Nielsen, Robin Blume-Kohout
arxiv-1908-09855.description: Abstract Crosstalk occurs in most quantum computing systems with more than one qubit. It can cause a variety of correlated and nonlocal crosstalk errors that can be especially harmful to fault-tolerant quantum error correction, which generally relies on errors being local and relatively predictable. Mitigating crosstalk errors requires understanding, modeling, and detecting them.

arxiv-2011-13238.title: Towards Interpretable Multilingual Detection of Hate Speech against Immigrants and Women in Twitter at SemEval-2019 Task 5
arxiv-2011-13238.creator: Alvi Md Ishmam
arxiv-2011-13238.description: Abstract This paper describes our techniques to detect hate speech against women and immigrants on Twitter in multilingual contexts, particularly in English and Spanish. The challenge was designed by SemEval-2019 Task 5, where the participants need to design algorithms to detect hate speech in English and Spanish language with a given target (e.g., women or immigrants).

arxiv-2112-01455.title: Zero-Shot Text-Guided Object Generation with Dream Fields
arxiv-2112-01455.creator: Ajay Jain, Ben Mildenhall, Jonathan T. Barron, Pieter Abbeel, Ben Poole
arxiv-2112-01455.description: Abstract We combine neural rendering with multi-modal image and text representations to synthesize diverse 3D objects solely from natural language descriptions. Our method, Dream Fields, can generate the geometry and color of a wide range of objects without 3D supervision.

arxiv-2302-11349.title: Steerable Equivariant Representation Learning
arxiv-2302-11349.creator: Sangnie Bhardwaj, Willie McClinton, Tongzhou Wang, Guillaume Lajoie, Chen Sun, Phillip Isola, Dilip Krishnan
arxiv-2302-11349.description: Abstract Pre-trained deep image representations are useful for post-training tasks such as classification through transfer learning, image retrieval, and object detection. Data augmentations are a crucial aspect of pre-training robust representations in both supervised and self-supervised settings. Data augmentations explicitly or implicitly promote invariance in the embedding space to the input image transformations.

arxiv-2307-05684.title: The Signature of the Northern Galactic Center Region in Low-Velocity UV Absorption
arxiv-2307-05684.creator: Christian Soto, Trisha Ashley, Andrew J. Fox, Rongmon Bordoloi
arxiv-2307-05684.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Christian Soto, Trisha Ashley, Andrew J. Fox, Rongmon Bordoloi. The Galactic Center (GC) is surrounded by plasma lobes that extend up to ∼ \sim 14 kpc above and below the plane. Until now, UV absorption studies of these lobes have only focused on high-velocity components ( | v LSR | > 100 |v_{\rm LSR}|>100 km s -1 ) because low- and intermediate-velocity (LIV) components ( | v LSR | < 100 |v_{\rm LSR}|<100 km s -1 ) are blended with foreground interstellar medium.

pmc-10994605.title: Functional capacity in smoking patients after coronary artery bypass grafting surgery: a quasi-experimental study
pmc-10994605.creator: Mohammed Essa Alsubaiei, Wadha Althukair, Hind Almutairi
pmc-10994605.description: Coronary artery bypass grafting surgery (CABG) is an important approach to treating coronary heart disease. pmc-12508480.title: Identification, structural features, and potential functional significance of the myodural Bridge in African clawed frog, the Xenopus laevis
pmc-12508480.creator: Heng Yang, Xue Song, Chen Yue, Jin Gong, Wei Ma, Ruo-Tong Zhang, Jing-Xian Sun, Tai-Lai Li, Campbell Gilmore, Xu-Hui Zhang, Jing Zhang, Yang Song, Sheng-Bo Yu, Cong-Yi Li, Wei Tang, Chan Li, Hong-Jin Sui
pmc-12508480.description: The myodural bridge (MDB) is an anatomical structure located in the suboccipital region, consisting of a dense fibrous connective tissue bridge connecting the suboccipital muscles to the dura mater (DM). These fibres interweave with their originating muscles and the dura, forming a functional unit known as the “myodural bridge complex” (MDBC).

pmc-12670705.title: Click for Care, Care for Planet: Sustainable Marketing Drivers of Telemedicine Adoption
pmc-12670705.creator: Altuğ Ocak
pmc-12670705.description: Purpose:This study examines telemedicine as a sustainable service innovation that combines health, environmental and convenience benefits. It explores how these perceived benefits influence attitudes and intentions to use telemedicine and how trust in the provider shapes this relationship.Design/Methodology:A cross-sectional online survey was conducted with 400 adults who had used or planned to use telemedicine.

pmc-12957686.title: Cdkn2a/p16Ink4a loss impairs Spatial memory independently of Alzheimer’s-associated genetic pathways in young adult mice
pmc-12957686.creator: Pauline Stephan, Damien Plassard, William M. Keyes, Yann Hérault
pmc-12957686.description: BackgroundThe cyclin-dependent kinase inhibitor CDKN2A/p16INK4A (p16INK4A) is a central regulator of cellular senescence, widely studied in ageing and cancer. Although its expression increases with age and disease, its role in the adult brain remains poorly defined. Recent evidence suggests a possible contribution to neuroinflammation and cognitive decline in Alzheimer’s disease (AD), but underlying mechanisms are unclear.

pmc-13476119.title: Multiple surgical excision for bilateral multiple mediastinal liposarcoma: a case report
pmc-13476119.creator: Suxin Jiang, Zhihao Wang, Jienong Zhao, Yong Han, Hongcan Shi
pmc-13476119.description: Multiple giant mediastinal liposarcomas are rare and associated with a high propensity for recurrence. Here we report the case of a 40-year-old male patient who underwent multiple surgical resections for mediastinal liposarcoma.

pmc-13589774.title: 健脾解毒优化方对结直肠癌患者化疗毒副作用及肠道菌群的影响：一项前瞻性对照研究
pmc-13589774.creator: 重杰 王, 金辉 刘, 林子 陈, 海霞 晏, 端阳 郭, 四方 张
pmc-13589774.description: 目的结直肠癌(colorectal carcinoma，CRC)患者在接受化疗过程中常出现胃肠道反应、体重下降和骨髓抑制等不良反应，影响治疗的连续性和患者的功能状态。肠道菌群失衡与CRC进展、化疗相关不良反应及患者对化疗的反应有关。本研究旨在观察健脾解毒优化方(Jianpi Jiedu optimized formula，JPJDYHF)辅助化疗治疗Ⅲ~Ⅳ期CRC患者的临床效果、安全性及其对肠道菌群结构的影响。方法前瞻性纳入121例原发性Ⅲ~Ⅳ期CRC患者，按患者意愿分为联合组(JPJDYHF联合化疗)与对照组(单纯化疗)。对照组接受中国临床肿瘤学会(Chinese Society of Clinical Oncology，CSCO)指南推荐的一线化疗方案，联合组在此基础上分阶段口服JPJDYHF1号方和2号方。剔除脱落病例后，对完成6个化疗周期的113例患者，以年龄、性别、TNM分期、化疗方案等9项基线变量构建倾向评分匹配(propensity score matching，PSM)模型，采用1:1最邻近匹配(卡钳值0.25)筛选出60例患者(每组30例)进行统计分析。记录首周期至第2周期的化疗通过情况；于各化疗周期结束时评估客观缓解率(objective response rate，ORR)、疾病控制率(disease control rate，DCR)、Karnofsky功能状态(Karnofsky Performance Status，KPS)评分、中医证候积分及化疗相关不良反应(胃肠道反应、体重减轻、骨髓抑制)；检测化疗前后血清癌胚抗原(carcinoembryonic antigen，CEA)与糖类抗原19-9(carbohydrate antigen 19-9，CA19-9)水平及肝肾功能。于6个化疗周期结束后，采集粪便样本，提取总DNA，针对16S核糖体RNA(16S ribosomal RNA，16S rRNA)基因V3~V4区进行高通量测序，评估Alpha与Beta多样性，采用线性判别分析效应量(linear discriminant analysis effect size，LEfSe)筛选差异菌群，并采用基于未观测状态重建的群落系统发育调查2(Phylogenetic Investigation of Communities by Reconstruction of Unobserved States 2，PICRUSt2)和同源蛋白簇(Clusters of Orthologous Groups，COG)数据库进行功能预测。结果经PSM后，2组基线特征均衡。临床疗效方面，联合组化疗通过情况优于对照组，ORR(46.67% vs 16.67%)和DCR(90.00% vs 73.33%)均更高(均P<0.05)。联合组的中医证候疗效总有效率达73.3%，高于对照组的30.0%(P<0.05)。第3周期和第6周期时，联合组的KPS评分均高于对照组(均P<0.05)。安全性与不良反应方面，第6周期结束时联合组的胃肠道反应严重程度、体重下降程度及骨髓抑制发生情况均较对照组改善(均P<0.05)，且2组肝肾功能指标变化的差异均无统计学意义(均P˃0.05)。血清学指标方面，第5、6周期结束时联合组的CEA水平低于对照组，且下降率更高(均P<0.05)，但CA19-9水平和下降率的差异均无统计学意义(均P˃0.05)。肠道菌群分析显示，2组Alpha多样性无差异(P˃0.05)，而Beta多样性存在显著分离(P<0.05)。LEfSe分析表明，联合组拟杆菌门(Bacteroidota)、梭杆菌门(Fusobacteriota)及弯曲杆菌门(Campylobacterota)的相对丰度下降；属水平上，拟杆菌属(Bacteroides)、副拟杆菌属(Parabacteroides)和促癌相关梭杆菌属(Fusobacterium)的相对丰度下降，而产短链脂肪酸的布劳特氏菌属(Blautia)、瘤胃球菌科-UCG-014(Ruminococcaceae-UCG-014)的相对丰度升高(均P<0.

uslaw-usc-t2-s4505.title: 2 U.S.C. § 4505 — Voluntary separation incentive payments
uslaw-usc-t2-s4505.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t2-s4505.description: United States Code, Title 2 (The Congress); Chapter 45 (Congressional Pay And Benefits); Subchapter I (General); Part A (Amount And Type). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) Authority to offer payments Notwithstanding any other provision of law, the head of any office in the legislative branch may establish a program under which voluntary separation incentive payments may be offered to eligible employees.
